Name: (CP) Quality Charcoal Kiln
Author: tikamin557
Description:
To save space and to avoid wasting vanilla charcoal kilns.
Once the Foraging reaches levels 6 and 8, you will receive an mail with a recipe included.

It takes a little longer than the vanilla charcoal kiln, but it produces a little more coals than the amount of charcoal kiln used in the recipe.

English and Japanese are supported.
